description.narrative: 2.1.2 Number of shared content on climate resilient agriculture including but not limited to documents, data, knowledge and practices linked with the platform At least 30 shared content on climate resilient agriculture linked with the platform

comment.narrative: Monitoring reports of the platform

Totally 148 contents on climate resilient agriculture were shared through the platform. 33 reports 8 news 15 educational videos are found on the Climate Resilient Agriculture platform. Moreover 24 activities were announced with this platform. The platform allows personalized queries regarding the climatic extreme events in different regions and adaptation methods. Notifications of 68 climatic extreme disasters were made by network members using the ClimAgri application.
